title: ATB improvement-feeder Tier-3 candidate entries
description: Strict schema for the Codex (Tier-3) draft of candidate IMPROVEMENT_LOG.md entries. Drafts only — the overseer + Korab certify into the log (doer != certifier). tag is the universal-vs-build-specific judgment, the one call only a frontier model makes.

finding.description: The system-level learning, one sentence — what creaked in ATB-the-system (not the build's own code).

tag.description: universal = recurs across build types -> worth building into the scaffolding; build-specific = an artifact of one contract or the pure-function monoculture -> must NOT be baked in.

rationale.description: Why this is universal or build-specific — the anti-over-fit reasoning.

proposed_fix.description: The concrete fix or change to the system.

where_it_lands.description: Which tool / gate / doc the fix lands in (e.g. gate_sweep.py, CLAUDE.md gotchas).

confidence.description: Codex's confidence that this is a real, actionable system improvement.

source_class_ids.description: The Tier-2 recurrence class_ids this finding draws on (>=1). The tool renders the verified recurrence from these classes — Codex must NOT invent counts in prose. Each must exist in this run's classes (re-validated independently).
